---
title: Herb Fritters
id: MAR-0039
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 40
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 200 g flour
- 2 eggs
- 5 tablespoons grated pecorino cheese
- 50 g chopped aromatic herbs (parsley, basil to taste, marjoram to taste, sage to taste, mint to taste)
- 1 teaspoon baking powder
- to taste frying oil,
- to taste salt and pepper,
## Method
1. Pour the sifted flour into the immersion blender cup, add the baking powder, eggs, pecorino, a generous grind of pepper, and salt.
2. Blend, adding warm water in the amount needed to obtain a consistent batter.
3. Incorporate the chopped herbs and let the batter rest for 30 minutes at room temperature.
4. Heat plenty of oil and fry the mixture by spoonfuls, a few at a time.
5. Drain the fritters, place them on paper towels, and serve hot.
